name: Africa Israel Residences Ltd
summary: Africa Israel Residences Ltd develops and sells residential units under the Savyonim brand in Israel. It is involved in the initiation, planning, development, construction, and marketing of residential housing units; establishment, management, and maintenance of rental housing projects and the provision of services. The company also engages in constructing and operating commercial properties for rental. Africa Israel Residences Ltd was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Or Yehuda, Israel. Africa Israel Residences Ltd is a subsidiary of Africa Israel Trade and Agencies Ltd.
